status: x-y-time-only ultrafine-place x speed-turn feasibility preflight frozen before any <500-m vertical outcome
role: post-freeze exploratory spatial-localization stress test; cannot alter frozen v0.3.8
hypothesis_origin: Opened after centered vertical individuality survived matched 500-m place × speed×turn conditioning in all four structurally evaluable non-Eidolon panels.

feasibility.target_support: A target kinematic endpoint is supported when its fine-cell × speed×turn state occurs in at least one other session of the same individual and in at least one session from another individual in the same cohort.
feasibility.individual_evaluable: at least one target session with >=50 supported endpoints
feasibility.panel_gate: retain at least 70% of the frozen 500-m baseline n and at least 5 individuals in every panel
feasibility.sequential_selection: Evaluate 250 m first. Only if all four panels pass the frozen gate, evaluate 100 m. If 100 m also passes all four, select 100 m; otherwise select 250 m. If 250 m fails, stop before any <500-m vertical outcome.

planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.ecological_question: Does the four-panel vertical-identity result persist after spatial matching is tightened below 500 m while broad speed×turn state remains matched?
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.estimator: P(centered residual height | selected fine cell, speed×turn state), equal-session self, equal-individual other, identical self-derived joint-stratum weights
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.calibration: reuse frozen whole-session permutation B/seeds from kinematic-state-conditioning-v1
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.panel_pass_rule: exact preflight-selected n; calibrated identity > 0; one-sided p(null>=observed)<=0.05
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.synthesis: 3 or 4 PASS => route/resource allocation at or above the selected ultrafine grid remains insufficient in this subset; 1 or 2 => mixed; 0 => ultrafine spatial allocation becomes a leading explanation.

claim_boundary: Fine cells are matching strata, not verified exact flight paths, feeding trees or resources.
A PASS at 100 or 250 m does not rule out sub-grid microhabitat or microclimate.
This refinement is opened after positive 500-m results and is a stress test, not independent confirmation.
stop_rule: Do not change the 250/100-m sequence, speed2_turn2 definition, 70% retention, >=5 floor, 50-event support, panel set, or baseline n after preflight output.
If 250 m fails, do not open 100 m or any vertical outcome.
Do not introduce an intermediate grid after seeing results.
If a grid is selected, freeze its exact evaluable n before any vertical outcome.
